# Strange Docs
> Evidence-first archive of declassified documents, court records and FOIA releases.

## Topics
- [The Epstein Files](https://strangedocs.com/topics/epstein/): Court records, flight logs, FBI files and DOJ releases — what the paper trail actually proves, and which viral claims have no paper trail at all.
- [9/11: The Documents](https://strangedocs.com/topics/sept11/): The Commission Report, the NIST engineering studies, the declassified 28 pages and the FBI Vault — the primary record of September 11, 2001.
- [The JFK Files](https://strangedocs.com/topics/jfk/): Six million pages and counting: the NARA assassination-records releases, including the 80,000-page 2025 tranche.
- [The Deep State, On the Record](https://strangedocs.com/topics/intel-abuses/): The parts of 'deep state' lore that turned out to be real — proven by official investigations, not internet threads.
- [Rothschild & Morgan](https://strangedocs.com/topics/bankers/): Two banking dynasties: the documented history versus the conspiracy claims — checked against archives and fact-checkers.
- [Bohemian Grove & Bilderberg](https://strangedocs.com/topics/grove/): Secretive elite gatherings are real. Secret world government is not. The documented facts, separated from the folklore.
- [Satanic Panic & Adrenochrome](https://strangedocs.com/topics/satanic-panic/): From the McMartin trial to QAnon: the origin chain of ritual-abuse claims, and what investigators actually found.
- [The Clinton Files](https://strangedocs.com/topics/clinton/): The FBI email investigation, the Benghazi report and the Clinton Foundation — findings versus talking points.
- [Bush-Era Files](https://strangedocs.com/topics/bush-era/): Torture memos, WMD intelligence and the CIA interrogation report — the declassified paper trail of the 2000s.
- [Vietnam-Era Files](https://strangedocs.com/topics/vietnam-war/): The Gulf of Tonkin deception and the Pentagon Papers — the declassified record of how America went to war in Vietnam.
- [Mass Surveillance Files](https://strangedocs.com/topics/surveillance/): From Snowden's disclosures to the archives that hold them — the documented scale of NSA surveillance.
- [Watergate](https://strangedocs.com/topics/watergate/): The tapes that ended a presidency — the 'smoking gun' and the cover-up, on the record.
- [RFK & MLK Files](https://strangedocs.com/topics/rfk-mlk/): The 2025 releases under Executive Order 14176 — 230,000+ pages on the King assassination and new RFK tranches.
